prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Visibility Status Check Screen: Inserts a pre-finish desktop visibility check screen right after waiting to verify that the generated pet is visible on screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_visibility_check", "home_intro"]}, "new_desktop_visibility_check": {"headline": "Confirm Pet Appearance on Desktop", "body": "Check your screen to verify your pet rendered properly before completing setup.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Pet Is Visible"}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Discovery Layout: Redesigns the path selection screen into a story_scroll layout that blends narrative context directly with companion path selection.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Journey", "body": "Scroll to explore companion paths and pick how you want to bring your pet to life."}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post Certificate Account Security Reorder: Moves sign_in screen to immediately follow adoption certificate generation so users bind their account after their pet choice is created.
   config: {"sign_in": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "headline": "Secure Your New Pet to Account", "body": "Sign in to bind your newly created companion to your account so you never lose them."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Audio Companion Preview Subflow: Adds an audio voice preview screen in the adoption flow to let users listen to companion sound effects before confirming adoption.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_audio_preview", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_audio_preview": {"headline": "Listen to Voice & Sound Cues", "body": "Test your companion's vocalizations and sound effects before adoption.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "sound", "text": "Play sound sample", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Tip Carousel: Adds an auto-rotating tip carousel component to the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"tip_delay_seconds": 6, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Useful tips while your pet is generated", "style": "subtle"}]}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "text": "Unlocks special desktop animations and audio cues!", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip"}]}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Keep & Restore Your Pets", "body": "Signing in ensures your desktop companion and save state are safely linked to your account."}}
7: [home, notification] Background Pet Generation System Notification: Enables native background notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
8: [finish, hint] Tray Menu Quick Access Hint: Adds a hint callout on the home intro screen detailing how to hide, show, and summon pet controls via the system tray.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to open controls, converse, or minimize your pet."}}
9: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Confirmation: Changes adoption certificate screen to a split layout displaying pet details on one side and adoption confirmation on the other.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Review your companion's details and finalize adoption to bring them to your desktop."}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a visibility verification screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Redesigning choose_path into a story_scroll layout is permitted as long as it retains companion path selection.
Reordering sign_in to occur after the adoption certificate is explicitly allowed by Rule 4.
Adding an audio voice preview screen as a new step inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a tip carousel to the waiting screen during pet generation is allowed.
Onboarding copy highlights unlockable extra traits, violating Rule 3 which forbids mentioning free extras or gifts.
Updating sign-in copy to clarify account restoration and saving progress is allowed.
Enabling background notifications on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Adding a tray menu usage hint to the home intro overlay is permitted within onboarding.
Changing the adoption certificate layout to split view retains the certificate job and is allowed.
